records.objective: route using validated registry state without treating queue delivery as authority
records.mustNot: activate a resource because a transport exists

records.objective: select the minimum graph from registered-checked non-revoked resources
records.mustNot: plan with generated-unchecked or revoked resources

records.objective: emit durable execution evidence while invoking capabilities only in MAKE
records.mustNot: treat enqueue or ACK as independent completion proof

records.objective: verify registry and transport evidence independently without repair
records.mustNot: register producer output without checker evidence

records.objective: emit one unexecuted next seed that transport cannot auto-execute
records.mustNot: reactivate Maker or consume the next seed in the same Cycle
